query:
Produce an evidence-grounded B2B dossier on ONE company: Zafran Security (domain zafran.io; also zafran-security on Ashby/LinkedIn). Legal/operating name Zafran Security / Zafran Security Ltd. HQ New York, New York, United States; Israeli founders and Tel Aviv R&D. Founded 2022. Co-Founder & CEO Sanaz Yashar; Co-Founder & CTO Ben Seri. Series C $60M led by Menlo Ventures announced 2025-12-02; company-reported total funding $130M as of that date.

TODAY is 2026-09-08.

EVIDENCE LAW: every factual assertion needs a VERBATIM quote and the URL. NOT FOUND is correct. Never estimate or infer numbers. Distinguish company claims vs third-party reports. LinkedIn/Tracxn/CB Insights auto-estimates are ESTIMATES. Name people with exact title and URL. For any acquisition, rumour or contested item, state CONFIRMED / DENIED / UNRESOLVED, by whom, with quotes.

SAME-NAME LOCK: this is the cybersecurity company zafran.io. EXCLUDE: Zafran the spice/food brand; any HP ProBook/Probook laptop hits; Cogent Communications; cocktail-YouTuber Nick Fisher (the Zafran VP Marketing is Nicholas T. Fisher, linkedin.com/in/nicholastfisher); any other Sanaz/Ben/Snir who are not at this company.

ALREADY ESTABLISHED — do not re-derive; find what is NOT here:
- Product: AI-native Threat Exposure Management / Agentic Exposure Management; RemOps; Exposure Graph; add-ons Zafran Discover, Zafran Autonomous Workflows.
- Named customers/quotes on zafran.io: Kraft Heinz (Ricardo Lafosse CISO), Chipotle (Dave Estlick CISO), Netskope (James Robinson CISO), Ashland (Robert Schuetter CISO), unnamed Fortune 25 Healthcare CISO; Sallie Mae (Steve Lodin) on Series C post; OpenAI TAC program (June 8 2026) is a partnership/access program not necessarily a paying customer.
- Series C $60M Menlo 2025-12-02, total $130M company-reported; Amex Ventures Feb 24 2026; Cisco Investments Jul 22 2026 (investment, not acquisition).
- Ashby board slug zafran-security: ~27 open reqs including Senior Manager ABM & Integrated Campaigns (published 2026-06-17, reports to Head of Growth Marketing), BDR (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach), Sr Technical Marketing Manager, Senior Manager Field & Event Marketing (Chicago, published 2026-09-03), Director of Alliances (build from scratch, 2026-09-01).
- GTM stack named in reqs: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, "major ABM platforms" (unnamed). 6sense/Demandbase/Terminus/RollWorks/Mutiny/Folloze/Influ2/Madison Logic/Clay/Common Room/Gong/Marketo/Salesloft/Apollo NOT named in the 27 reqs — that is NOT FOUND, not "not installed".
- Leadership on zafran.io/about: Sanaz Yashar CEO, Ben Seri CTO, Rotem Peled-Dvir SVP Finance, Tom Anthony SVP Sales, Nick Fisher VP Marketing, Hadas Bergman VP Business Operations, Racheli Barouch-Haik VP HR, Itay Nachum VP Product, Christopher Phillips VP Customer Success. Board: Doug Leone (Sequoia), Lior Simon (Cyberstarts), Rama Sekhar (Menlo).
- Vari Kaur / Varinder Kaur, Head of Growth Marketing (linkedin.com/in/varinderkaur), joined ~May 2025.
- Reputation: CTech Jul 20 2026 claimed Cisco acquisition talks $150-200M; company/CEO DENIED — Globes Jul 22 quote Sanaz "Zafran is not being sold to Cisco but is about to make an investment"; company statement that Cisco made a strategic investment. Snir Havdala (co-founder/CPO) departure to NVIDIA CONFIRMED by CTech and company ("planned"; Itay Nachum assumed product leadership). CTech/anonymous exec claims ~$20M ARR, competitive struggles, high burn: UNRESOLVED third-party.
- AI Ark: employee_count 167 ESTIMATE; revenue 10-25M ESTIMATE; founded 2022; HQ New York.

TWELVE SECTIONS required:
1. Identity and disambiguation (legal name, HQ address if published, GTM seat vs Tel Aviv R&D, founding year, domains, LinkedIn, employee count WITH source, excluded same-name entities).
2. Product and who they sell to (own words, buyer title CISO/security, target universe size if quoted, integrations, pricing if published, named competitors).
3. Traction and named customers (every named customer, logo counts, ARR/revenue WHO claimed each number).
4. Funding (every round amount/date/lead/participants; total; valuation if reported; undisclosed strategic cheques named as undisclosed; use of proceeds).
5. Go-to-market hiring WITH QUOTES from job descriptions on HOW they find/reach accounts (lists, account research, outbound, ABM, field, events, tooling); compensation if published; reporting lines; roles open unusually long.
6. Marketing/ABM/intent tooling evidence per named tool. NOT FOUND per tool you cannot evidence.
7. Leadership and GTM org: every named exec and marketing/sales/partnerships/RevOps/CS person with exact title+URL; join dates; vacant GTM seats.
8. Operational pain and strategic moves in the company's own words.
9. Culture and resonance.
10. Timing events last nine months, newest first, dated.
11. Reputation and negatives REQUIRED: acquisition rumours CONFIRMED/DENIED/UNRESOLVED with quotes both sides; founder departures; slowing growth; layoffs; down-rounds; churn; lawsuits; negative reviews; sceptical commentary. Who reported, whether company responded, one line on approach implication.
12. Champion's team and vendors: other marketing people by name/title; agencies/contractors/vendors they credit.

Also: any stated target-account list size; whether Series C proceeds were earmarked for GTM; Glassdoor/employee sentiment if primary; pricing; exact HQ street address; Director of Product Marketing Molly Small; Heather Sr Field Marketing Manager named on careers page.
